name: Human-in-the-Loop Inquiry
description: Pauses agent autonomy and requests input, confirmation (Yes/No), or selection choices from the human operator.

prompt.description: The exact question, prompt, or clarification requested from the human user.

input_type.description: The UI interaction component to render: 'text' (input field), 'confirm' (Yes/No buttons), 'select' (single button choice).

options.description: List of button options for the user to click (e.g. ['Yes', 'No'] or custom choices).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum waiting time in seconds for the user to respond.
